title: Extra more Swords
description: This project will add more custom swords to your world.Every single sword will have its own ability.
body:
🗡️ **Extra More Swords**

Extra More Swords expands your Minecraft world by adding a wide variety of powerful and unique swords. Each sword comes with its own special ability and strength, making combat more exciting and strategic.

⚔️ **Features**

Adds multiple new swords to the game

Every sword has a unique ability and power

Includes effects like teleportation, elemental damage, and special attacks

Balanced for survival and adventure gameplay

Lightweight and easy to use in any modpack


✨ **Why Use This Mod?**
Tired of using the same basic weapons? Extra More Swords gives you a reason to switch your playstyle. Choose the right sword for every situation and experience Minecraft combat in a whole new way.

⭐ **Support & Follow**
If you enjoy this mod, don’t forget to follow me for future updates, new swords, and more awesome features coming soon!
